subject: SCIENCE
title: Motion from a Reference Point
objective: Describe position and motion relative to a named reference point.
introduction: Motion is change in position relative to a reference point over time. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: An exact spot in space, marked with a dot.
The way something moves from one place to another.
A starting point used to tell where something is.
